**ACCEPT** — PR #6476, head `fc9eb5558`. Verified against the tree.

### The escape hatch was closed by measurement, not by assertion

The dispatch offered a fork: if "blank on close" turned out to be the deliberate choice for a params form, converge on *that* and record why. The right way to close that fork is what happened here — **the reading did not survive contact with the code**. Typed values are not in `paramState` at all; they live in `ActionParamDialog`'s own `values` state, which its effect reseeds on every `open` false→true edge. So a type / close / reopen round trip reopens blank under **both** shapes. Nothing a user observes beyond the fade differs, so there is no product-semantics question and no decision card is owed.

That is a materially better answer than "I picked the shape #6034 picked". The charter said the measurement decides; it did.

And the measurement of the divergence itself is concrete: across the real exit window the blanking shape re-titles the closing dialog from the action's label to the generic `actionDialog.title`, swaps the description, and drops both param rows for the whole ~200 ms fade.

### ⭐⭐ The instrument note is the best thing in this report

jsdom has no CSS engine, so Radix `Presence` unmounts synchronously and **the exit window does not exist unless it is modelled**. A constant `getComputedStyle` stub **silently failed to open it** — `Presence` suspends only when the mount-time and close-time `animationName` *differ*, so a constant value means no exit phase at all.

A test built on that stub would have been green, and green about nothing: it would have measured a dialog that never animates, on a card whose entire subject is what renders *during* the animation. Deriving `animationName` from the node's live `data-state`, and then **measuring the model's own premise** by reading `data-[state=closed]:animate-out` / `data-[state=open]:animate-in` / `duration-200` off the shipped `DialogContent`, is what makes the instrument trustworthy rather than merely present.

### ⚠️ The card said two runtimes. There are three — and my census had it on screen

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/MetadataTypeActions.tsx:245` still closes with `setParamState({ open: false, params: [] })`, so after this PR it is **the only one of three on the blanking shape**. Confirmed, along with the reason it is not the same mechanical call: `:244` calls `paramState.resolve?.(null)` itself — a second settle on an already-settled promise, and whether that line stays is a decision this card's measurement does not imply. Correctly filed as #6473 rather than folded in.

**This one is mine.** When I located this card's file face I ran a grep for `ActionParamDialog|paramState` across `app-shell`, and `MetadataTypeActions.tsx` was **in the output**. I declared the face as the two files the card named and scanned past the third.

That is a different failure from the two file-face errors I made earlier today. Those were wrong searches. This was the right search, read carelessly — the census ran, returned the answer, and I did not look at it. Worth naming separately, because "run a better grep" would not have prevented it.

### The rest, verified

The behavioural diff is **one line**: `setParamState({ open: false, params: [] })` → `setParamState(s => ({ ...s, open: false }))`. The rationale is recorded at the divergence site with a pointer at `RecordDetailView`'s close, so that line does not get "cleaned up" later. `ActionResultDialog` is untouched, as the named control.

Reverse verification predicted **exactly 3 red / 6 controls green** before running and observed exactly that — the DOM pin, the console state pin and the cross-runtime equality. The mutation was proven on disk in both directions, including reading the mutated line back off disk verbatim, never a diffstat. Restore proven byte-for-byte against the `HEAD` blob under a trap holding absolute paths.

Lint was **not** narrowed — the whole `app-shell` package, 976 files from eslint's own config, 0 errors.

**Clause-②: no public surface change.** No `**/src/index.ts` touched, no export line added or removed, no published type gains a member; the change is one call site inside a component body.
